EmailTemplate.subject: Is your A/R process scaring off your customers?
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hi {{lead.First Name:default=Friend}}, In your industry, the competition is fierce. Your competitors who are tackling their global payment strategy and tying it to their overall Accounts Receivable (A/R) process are winning.
So how can your team get ahead of the competition and retain your customers? Your A/R may be the answer.
Your A/R process touches every existing customer and their renewal. Did you know you're 60-70% likely to sell to an existing customer, compared to the 5-20% likelihood of selling to a new prospect?
After speaking with many customers, our EVP & GM of B2B at Flywire, Ryan Frere, has put together a list of five ways executive teams are thinking about A/R functions as strategic levers of growth. <[[https://www.flywire.com/resources/how-b2b-companies-are-using-accounts-receivable-to-help-grow-their-business?utm_source=marketo&utm_medium=email]]>
Thank you, Josh Easterly
